ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Who is the producer in the food web shown?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a left-to-right food chain. It begins with grass, followed by an arrow to a grasshopper, then an arrow to a frog, then an arrow to a snake, and finally an arrow to an eagle. Reasoning: In a food web or food chain, the producer is the organism that makes its own food, usually a plant at the start of the chain. The plant shown at the beginning is grass, so the producer is grass.
